==Usage==
This template should be placed at the top of the actual [[Wookieepedia:Featured article nominations|Featured article nomination]] page to be archived. To use this template, copy and paste one of the following:
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:FA archive|successful}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{subst:FA archive}}</nowiki></code> for successful nominations, or
*<code><nowiki>{{subst:FA archive|unsuccessful}}</nowiki></code> for unsuccessful nominations.

Finally, add a <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code> tag at the very end of the page.
